messages:
Sam Li: Acme POC ready to sign. They pushed three blockers: net-60 payment terms, removed subprocessors clause from the DPA, and want to send the DocuSign envelope from their tenant. Link to redline: https://acme.example.com/dpa-redline

Marta Ortiz: Procurement needs a PO by 2026-03-29 or pilot can't start. Can we get a signed agreement by EOD Mon? :alarm_clock:

Leah Chen: Reading the redline now. Two clarifying q's: 1) Did they remove all KMS/HSM references? 2) Who owns exec approval if we deviate on subprocessors? @Sam Li

Sam Li: They replaced subprocessors paragraph with: ``Company may restrict or prohibit the use of subprocessors without prior written consent; all subprocessors must execute equivalent security obligations.`` Also noted they won't accept language referencing third-party key hosting.

Leah Chen: We can't accept full removal. Counter: allow customer approval for high-risk subprocessors with a fast review SLA (5 business days) and require subprocessors listed in a schedule. I'll post a redline suggestion in ~2h. :memo:

Devin Park: Finance note: net-60 is non-standard. For POC we can do net-45 one-time if legal signs off and we get an upfront PO for the pilot amount. If they insist on net-60, need exec sign-off. Who's the sponsor? @Marta Ortiz

Marta Ortiz: Sponsor = Ben (VP Product). I'll loop him in and ask procurement contact about billing currency (they requested EUR).

Tina Kapoor: Security asks: need SOC2, and confirm whether they require dedicated KMS keys. If they removed KMS text we need rationale. Sharing security questionnaire: https://redwood.example.com/sec-qn

Sam Li: Uploaded preliminary security answers: https://drive.example.com/acme/sec-answers.txt

Marta Ortiz: E-sign routing: Acme wants to originate envelope from their DocuSign. Our preference is to send from our tenant to preserve audit trail. Options: 1) accept external envelope if they include our legal + sales signer and deliver executed PDF to contracts@redwood.com within 24h, 2) we originate from our tenant. Thoughts? @Leah Chen @Devin Park

Leah Chen: Prefer we send it. If external tenant is mandatory, require a C-level signature on their side and a clause guaranteeing access to audit logs. Otherwise we accept external only if our signatory is included.

docsign-bot: EnveloperDraft created by marta_salesops for Acme — draft id 0x7a3. Waiting for signers.

Sam Li: I'll update the order form: set billing currency to EUR, placeholder net-45, include Leah's interim subprocessor language, and route from our tenant. ETA for updated OF and DPA: 2026-03-25 17:00 UTC. I'll ping Ben for exec approval if they insist on net-60.

Marta Ortiz: I'll prepare PO template and vendor onboarding checklist and share with procurement.

Devin Park: Finance tentatively OK with net-45 + PO. If exec approves net-60 we'll adjust accounting. Keep me posted.

Tina Kapoor: After the updated DPA is posted I'll confirm if dedicated KMS is required and whether extra controls are needed.

Sam Li: Thanks all — posting updated redlines and order form shortly. :thumbsup:
